import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Filter features with significant t-test (p < 0.05) and large effect size
    sig_features = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        # Use mean_y1-mean_y0 as proxy for effect size
        effect_size = feats.types[i] if isinstance(feats.types[i], (int, float)) else 0
        if abs(effect_size) > 0.1:  # Simplified filter based on effect size
            sig_features.append(fid)
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    keep_features = []
    used = set()
    for fid in sig_features:
        if fid in used:
            continue
        keep_features.append(fid)
        # Mark correlated features as used
        for other_fid in sig_features:
            if other_fid != fid and other_fid not in used:
                col1 = feats.column(fid)
                col2 = feats.column(other_fid)
                corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2])[0, 1]
                if abs(corr) >= 0.6:
                    used.add(other_fid)
    
    # Select top drivers by effect size
    drivers = []
    if len(keep_features) > 0:
        # Use mean difference as proxy for effect size
        effects = []
        for fid in keep_features:
            col = feats.column(fid)
            y1_mean = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y == 1, col])
            y0_mean = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y == 0, col])
            effects.append(abs(y1_mean - y0_mean))
        
        # Sort by effect size
        sorted_indices = np.argsort(effects)[::-1][:MAX_DRIVERS]
        drivers = [keep_features[i] for i in sorted_indices if effects[i] > 0.05]
    
    # Build columns, products, and loadings
    columns = tuple(keep_features[:10])  # Top 10 features for regression
    products = []
    loadings = {}
    
    # Simple loading: use standardized effect sizes
    for fid in columns:
        col = feats.column(fid)
        y1_mean = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y == 1, col])
        y0_mean = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y == 0, col])
        loadings[fid] = y1_mean - y0_mean
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(drivers),
        columns=columns,
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
